newsitem.title: UK: ATHLETICS-JOHNSON PULLS OUT OF SHEFFIELD GRAND PRIX.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-JOHNSON PULLS OUT OF SHEFFIELD GRAND PRIX.

text.p: World and Olympic champion Michael Johnson, beaten over 400 metres for the first time for eight years on Wednesday, has pulled out of the Sheffield Grand Prix meeting on Sunday.
"He pulled out in the early hours of this morning," British Athletics Federation spokeswoman Jayne Pearce said on Thursday.

Johnson, who pulled a hamstring in his 150 metres showdown with Donovan Bailey earlier this month, finished a poor fifth in the Paris Grand Prix in 45.76 seconds. Fellow American Antonio Pettigrew won in 44.86.
"Due to the fact he missed training because of his injury, he's not in as good shape as he'd like to be," said Pearce.
"We are disappointed but we understand. We've still got a great meeting."
